hints.title: Marginal Gain Formula
hints.text: Notice that incrementing a digit d to d + 1 yields a marginal increase in squared sum of (d + 1)^2 - d^2 = 2d + 1.

hints.title: Greedy Selection
hints.text: Because 2d + 1 is strictly increasing with d, larger digits yield greater marginal gains than smaller digits.

hints.title: Heap Maintenance
hints.text: Use a priority queue to greedily increment the digit offering the maximum marginal gain up to the bound of 9.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Priority queue extracts maximal marginal gain digit per operation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive combinatorial allocation takes exponential time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Compute marginal difference formula and apply greedy priority queue.
